The host receipt consumer retains exact theory and candidate-slice association and checks the result count. Neither check proves the soundness of a verdict or its association with the right position within that slice, so the batch laws take a sound route for the selected operation as an explicit premise; each route is zetesis’s own and is qualified with it. Exact residual completion uses the existing host checker; an interruption or fault cannot discharge its pending candidates. Rust ownership, resource compliance and transport identities remain implementation obligations.

Adaptive GPU batching, the default for GPU formula sessions, chooses each proposal target at the next selection after a complete successful commit, from the committed slate’s fill, the candidate bound’s generation, the pending owner’s memory capacity and a shortened checked device prefix. None of these observations is semantic evidence. Failed checks preserve pending candidates and the prior target. The existing batch laws still require exact classification of every occurrence before commit. Checked sizing, allocation refusals and propagation of prefix observations remain Rust obligations.

Scalar and joined batch proposals retain one original EvaluationWorkspace per owner. Every new candidate checks exact theory identity and recomputes original truth, resetting numeric validity; capacity reuse supplies no semantic receipt. Failed validation retains only the checked prefix. External-checker retry uses that pending prefix without evaluating it again. Actual workspace capacity and its header share the pending-byte allowance, and optional oversized scratch can be released when that allowance decreases. Validation work is recorded apart from search and reduct work. The existing evaluation and batch laws express the required truth and occurrence invariants; they do not verify these Rust resets, failure paths, retained-capacity charges or their composition with publication.

Representation and source laws

The zetesis facade’s construction macros generate the canonical themelios constructors, and its modules re-export the original upstream types. These exports add no admission or lowering step. Macro translation, source admission and concrete lowering remain executable correspondence obligations; re-exporting a type does not establish them.

The zetesis-engine adapter connects these values to native CPU sessions. Its remaining correspondence obligations include preserving the program at lower, enumerating the full unscored family, exporting every atom, keeping display selection separate, and mapping a completed or interrupted run to its actual conclusion. Named-part refusal retains the exact canonical part key, without a fabricated statement or span. Executable conformance tests exercise this boundary; they are not an end-to-end Lean proof. The existing scalar-checker refinement does not establish adapter or query-layer correctness.

Source admission checks authored syntax before raising; typed admission bounds the canonical rule, term and symbol structure. A logical program cannot recover an erased empty program section or the original multiplicity of set-valued body syntax. The source checks therefore remain in place. Both doors now use formula preparation. The shared compiler, statement-evidence borrows and resource traversal remain Rust correspondence obligations; semantic laws alone establish neither source admission nor equality of the two doors’ admitted input sets.

The full formula door, prepare_program_formula, borrows the canonical program for structural, text and provenance preflight before normalization and analysis. It then uses the same formula compiler and grounding routes as source admission. The original Arc<logical::Program> remains available through preparation, grounding and typed-input refusals. A statement ProgramSite identifies its position in that owner’s canonical order and carries a parsed coordinate only when one exists. Retaining the right owner, resolving those positions and preserving causes through deferred work remain Rust obligations. Neither shared code nor retained evidence proves source-to-ground equivalence or makes the source and canonical admission boundaries interchangeable.

Source scalar validation and construction share a bounded symbol walk and the core borrowed node’s text/spelling measures. The validation consumer retains logical bounds without constructing an output value; actual capacity admission belongs to construction. This changes storage work, not the value’s mathematical identity or the requirement to validate inactive authored expressions. The Rust borrowed-view correspondence, traversal and capacity checks remain executable obligations; no Lean source-to-value refinement is claimed by this separation.

The public symbols::term_with and symbols::atom_with exports construct an upstream Symbol from borrowed core values. Their contract preserves complete typed values and atom signs; display selection remains a separate operation. Their callbacks bound work and permit interruption before navigation, copying and assembly. TermRef::depth_with checks each step of an arbitrary ingress subtree’s allocation-free depth scan, whose worst-case work is quadratic; complete ingress roots and canonical terms use cached depth. These conversions, first-refusal behavior and cost bounds remain executable obligations. The refreshed evaluator extraction does not select the depth API or symbol exporter.

ColumnRelations relates complete typed tuples to aligned equality-ID columns. Dictionary round trips and exact cell encoding imply reconstruction; equality selection returns exactly the satisfying subsequence in original order. source_posting_exact preserves the complete ordered posting for one source equality, so a fixed shortest-posting chooser can retain its original matcher visits. row_mask_roundtrip decodes exact membership bits to the same increasing row selection; it assumes unique positions and the correct row domain. full_matches_preserved assumes a total Boolean matcher and that every complete match satisfies the prefilter. The Rust relation module provides checked owner-bound views. Construction, catalog mapping, resource accounting, fallible matching and any device masks still need executable correspondence arguments. The proof guide explains the hypotheses with a correlated-tuple example.

CompactColumns adds exact finite-word storage under explicit representability hypotheses. Successful packing preserves the complete column; widening preserves all old cells, and compact equality selection retains the same ordered rows. These laws cover the mathematical 8-, 16- and 32-bit representations. The Rust OwnedColumn storage must still establish width sufficiency, atomic publication and capacity accounting. The GPU transport must additionally establish its header offsets, word alignment and lane decoding. Host and physical tests check those boundaries; the abstract laws do not certify the Rust or WGSL implementations.

A consumer needing only the shortest posting can resolve each equality and retain that posting without materializing an owned query. Every requested equality must still be validated, including later columns after an absent value. The dictionary and posting laws apply to completed resolution; they do not justify skipping errors or charging work only after it has occurred.

Exact structural-argument probes use the same necessary-prefilter obligation. When every named input is bound and no wildcard occurs, reverse preorder must resolve the exact constructor value, preserving name, sign, arity, ordered children and aliases. A successful full match must therefore satisfy that whole-column equality; canonical absence must imply absence from the current support snapshot. The Rust structural probe uses the existing term lookup and column postings, then retains the complete matcher and source-occurrence delta interval. It writes no incoming slot and publishes no term. This exact-value probe cannot narrow a partially bound or anonymous argument.

For captured lazy constraints, the Rust PatternRows retains original row positions accepted by the structural matcher with an empty incoming binding. ConstructorPatterns.acceptance_iff_consistent and StructuralBindings.matching_complete supply the abstract necessity argument: a successful bound match gives a consistent extension, which also extends the empty binding, so additional incoming equalities cannot rescue a static mismatch. DomainBindings.guarded_continuations_exact preserves ordered complete continuations under such a necessary selection; TableBindings.join_family_preserved composes unchanged step families. The runtime may choose this posting or a smaller existing equality posting, while retaining the full matcher and original source atoms. This grants no candidate truth. Correspondence still requires complete pattern extraction, constants and aliases, exact occurrence and completed-carrier ownership, increasing row positions, and unchanged residual scalar and signed-body checks. Preparation runs after source-family capture; it cannot replace that validation or suppress its warnings. Fallible matching, charged preparation and retained capacity, cancellation, and interrupted prefixes remain Rust obligations. These general laws and executable regression tests do not constitute a refinement proof of PatternRows.

Within one Join, successful argument resolution may retain its complete scoped input projection and canonical result for the same immutable argument. BindingScopes.readAll_agrees states agreement on the selected inputs; CanonicalTemplates.substitute_decodes supplies the ordered substitution interface. Neither proves the reverse-preorder constructor resolver. Reuse requires present, equal inputs in the same vocabulary and a complete prior success. Current reader authentication remains necessary: equality of scoped IDs alone does not establish an accessible prefix. The fixed support and append-only writer must preserve prior successful identities; missing identities are never retained across growth. The full matcher and source-occurrence selection still run. Dependency extraction, complete record replacement, borrowed source lifetime, cancellation and leased-capacity accounting remain concrete Rust obligations.

Constructor lookup soundness/completeness, authenticated scope and prefix, reverse-preorder decoding, and leased scratch/refusal accounting remain Rust obligations. The column laws do not prove these operations. Executable regressions compare the complete recursive formula graph and source origins, original truth, and frozen truth for arbitrary candidate/tested interpretations. StructuralBindings.retained_atom_context gives the semantic context law once the same source atoms are retained; it supplies neither the concrete lookup proof nor a subset premise. Append and closed-support queries have separate storage envelopes, and neither may retain a missing identity across writer growth. No source-level executable refinement is claimed for this optimization.

The append dictionary’s canonical inverse implements the same encoder. Each published representative must have exactly one inverse entry naming its local equality ID, and every inverse entry must name that representative’s whole canonical term. Under this invariant, an authenticated identity miss is a true dictionary absence. The semantic AVL remains responsible for new-value placement and queries without an eligible canonical identity. Rust must preserve the invariant through append, refusal, capacity growth and clear, and validate the vocabulary and readable prefix before lookup. These transaction and resource properties are executable obligations; the dictionary round-trip laws do not prove a particular hash-map implementation.

FiniteTables relates intersections of value supports to surviving complete rows. Projection preserves these rows, contracts their domains and is idempotent for a single table. Recomputing from the original table preserves previously surviving rows when domains widen. The Rust primitive borrows typed values and retains row identity. Direct selection stops at an ordered row mask; full projection additionally returns witnessed domains.

TableBindings connects this row law to positive source matching. flat_match_survives derives alias coherence and necessary constant/incoming-binding domains from StructuralBindings.matching_sound; canonical table labels have explicit source argument origins. indexed_matches_preserved preserves the ordered list of row occurrences and resulting bindings. join_family_preserved composes equal step families over the same finite schedule, retaining full source-occurrence/row traces, including repeated predicates and duplicate-valued row positions.

The explicit table grounding strategy consumes completed possible support and retains the existing matcher. Structural patterns and growth-round snapshots keep indexed probes. Concrete scope construction, typed decoding, packed bits, owner lifetimes and cumulative resource accounting remain executable correspondence obligations. Relational mismatch in the mathematical matcher does not represent interruption or an undefined authored expression. Comparisons, negative conditions and aggregate validation keep their separate continuation; the table cannot silently prune a required error. Source rows remain original atoms in the emitted formulas. The binding guide separates these obligations from the independent support-coverage and reduct arguments.

AggregateDependencies.Reuse models finite reuse across parent frames under one fixed support. The builder receives only the complete projected input row; a missing input or failed build is a typed failure. Restart compares newly read projections of the retained and incoming frames, then resets the one successful carrier or builds a new one. restart_exact and reuse_rows_exact preserve the full ordered values and their current-parent association. clauses_exact maps successful traversal to the existing clause sequence, so original activation and every equality retain their original and arbitrary frozen M/J meaning. Carrier coverage still needs the existing coverage hypotheses. The abstract traversal compares whole completed lists or typed failures; it does not certify streamed failure prefixes, Rust invalidation, canonical value identity, dependency extraction, support lifetime, allocation, work charging or cancellation. Its finite output-step fuel is not a bound on those implementation costs.

The support producer’s completed_with check has a different observation boundary: it can omit an already exhausted continuation whose complete source read summary agrees under the same rule and support. AggregateDependencies.SupportReuse.reuse_exact states the separate mathematical law: a finite traversal may coalesce consecutive projections when all continuations are complete and equal projections determine the same head image, defined flag and first-zero diagnostic. Head union and this evidence are idempotent, with the earliest diagnostic retained. The module includes a counterexample showing that head-image equality alone is insufficient. This law concerns completed observations; an immediate fatal failure or an unfinished continuation supplies no completion premise. Completing one continuation does not finalize its enclosing source family’s arithmetic. It is distinct from reuse_rows_exact and clauses_exact, which preserve parent/child occurrences. Positive base matching still runs, and final formula emission retains every witness activation. The compiler’s conservative continuation_inputs extraction, generated versus relational slot separation, completed traversal, canonical ownership, resource charging and diagnostic identity remain Rust correspondence obligations. Support-only differential tests hold formula factorization disabled on both sides and compare the unchanged graph, roots, provenance and diagnostic outcomes; they do not prove the source scanner or a Lean implementation refinement.

The matched-row formula consumer reuses reached subformulas while retaining every complete producer occurrence. Original conjunction semantics and repeated application of RuleFactorization.reduct_conj justify balanced conjunction grouping for arbitrary frozen M and J, without asserting positive support atoms true. The Rust reuse key is an ordered tuple of row positions under one group’s fixed source occurrences and immutable join snapshot. Equal positions under another relation or snapshot are insufficient. Saved formula IDs must retain their meaning in the same append-only node owner. Only complete selected descendants may populate the maps; all producer conditions, roots and source origins must still be published.

These owner and traversal invariants, native node construction, cancellation and charged map operations remain executable correspondence obligations. Retained space grows with distinct reached subtuples, and sorted insertion can require quadratic total movement; the semantic laws supply neither resource bounds nor an admission guarantee. Differential tests compare original and arbitrary frozen truth, with exhaustive small cases and sampled larger cases. They do not prove the Rust map or producer traversal.

For independent component factoring, RuleFactorization.original_factorization and frozen_factorization prove the replacement of a complete Cartesian product of two finite body families by one implication whose antecedent conjoins their disjunctions. The conditions may be arbitrary formulas, and frozen equivalence holds for every M and J. The laws assume that product explicitly; they do not prove its extraction from source variables, arithmetic or completed support.

The Rust component route must establish independence after fixing the head, check fixed assignments as equalities, and retain every producer alternative. Its arithmetic certificate checks every matching completed head row before emission; undefined arithmetic declines the route, while typed resource and interruption failures propagate. The shared inhabited-witness preflight covers both the ordinary and arithmetic profiles: every component supplies a selected row before any component names atoms or records source provenance. This proves a complete substitution exists, not that its body is true. These checks, authoritative source-family diagnostics, provenance, rebuilt support guards and charged transient storage remain Rust correspondence obligations. Existing semantic laws do not establish an implementation refinement.

Component cursors share immutable ordering and comparison metadata only under the same support owner, literal scope and fixed-slot shape. Their held positive rows supply canonical atom identities at component-local literal positions; unchanged-prefix node reuse stays within one cursor and fixed head. Neither metadata nor identity reuse establishes body truth. Exact traversal, owner checks, storage receipts and skipped scalar-rejected rows remain executable correspondence obligations, covered by differential tests rather than new Lean refinement claims. CPU and GPU-selected sessions share this host preparation.

Formula witness sharing has its own observation boundary. RuleFactorization.original_factorization and frozen_factorization replace a finite family (W_i ∧ C) → H by ((∨ W_i) ∧ C) → H, specialized to one common continuation C and head H. Each W_i is a whole correlated positive witness, and C may be an arbitrary formula. The law applies separately when different continuations have different heads; its frozen equivalence holds for arbitrary M and J. The grouped antecedent also becomes the head’s producer. satisfies_any preserves the original truth of the OR of producer bodies, and Ferraris.double_neg_formula_reduct transports that equality through the actual double-negated support guards. The rebuilt guards must be included in the equivalence, rather than treated as an unchanged surrounding theory.

The Rust route groups only consecutive equal inputs under one rule and immutable support, using the complete continuation summary. It checks flat positive patterns and total prefix decisions before looking ahead, validates rejected rows, and waits for a selected complete row before publishing witness atoms. These applicability checks, complete tuple and scoped read coverage, active versus lookahead comparison certificates, typed ownership, arithmetic evidence and interruption/resource admission are executable correspondence obligations. Exhaustive small tests align decoded atom identities and compare the entire original and arbitrary frozen theories, including support guards; they do not establish a refinement of the Rust state machine.

SupportTransposition separately groups double-negated support guards by shared condition. Its SameIncidences premise requires every head-condition pair in either orientation to occur in the other. original_exact and frozen_exact preserve the truth of the whole guard family, with arbitrary outer and tested interpretations. answer_sets_in_context preserves membership in any unchanged surrounding theory. These laws replace equivalent guard families; they require neither a necessary-support entailment premise nor equivalence between individual roots.

The Rust guard builder selects heads with exactly one recorded producer. A conjunction contributes its direct children; another body contributes itself as one condition. Complete counting and filling by unchanged formula coordinates must establish the exact incidence premise. Ordinary roots and unselected guards remain the surrounding theory. Native disjunction and the theorem’s RuleFactorization.any need the same original truth, not identical syntax: double negation transports that truth to the arbitrary frozen interpretation. Completed producer metadata, stable operand storage, full source evidence and actual work, operand and storage admission remain executable obligations; the semantic theorem does not verify them.

The same module’s ConjunctOf relation follows conjunctions only. nested_conjunct_required and necessary_conjunct justify requiring a nested condition whenever a complete singleton producer’s head is true. The supplemental_original, supplemental_frozen and supplemental_answer_sets laws allow double-negated consequences to be appended while retaining the original guards. They require entailment of the added requirements; unlike direct transposition, they do not require two equivalent incidence tables. The Rust nested pass must establish complete producer eligibility, exact shared condition identity and duplicate-path handling. A reused disjunction must denote a covered subset of the requiring heads; the original guards still establish the requirements of every omitted head. The laws do not verify that traversal, canonical lookup or its resource behavior.

PairwiseExclusions replaces a complete family of pairwise negative conjunctions with one negated unit threshold at two. Its carrier has distinct indices; every edge has two distinct carrier endpoints, and every unordered carrier pair occurs. Edges may repeat or reverse. Conditions may be arbitrary formulas. original proves equal original truth, frozen equal truth at every frozen candidate and tested interpretation without a subset premise, and stable_in_context equal answer-set membership in any unchanged surrounding theory. The frozen step uses the general fact that a negative constraint freezes entirely according to its original truth.

The Rust pair collector uses exact interned atom-node identities after separately certified explicit facts are removed. A completed original constraint join delimits the population; source provenance alone cannot establish coverage. Sorting, duplicate-edge removal, component membership and the distinct-edge count must establish the Lean coverage premises. Eager compilation may replace separate complete components; hybrid capture retires a whole streamed template only when every passing row is a pair and every component is certified or has exactly two atoms. A two-atom component’s pair constraint is emitted once, since repeated and reversed occurrences are the same constraint, so its part of the retirement rests on that constraint itself rather than on the law. Full source validation, original atom and producer ownership, root provenance, typed failures, charged storage/work and the retirement of exact original rule positions remain executable obligations. The Lean law does not verify these Rust operations or native threshold storage and propagation. The compiler contract states their scope and resource boundary.

DomainProducers models possible argument values before binding enumeration. One producer intersects its mandatory inputs and local bound; alternative producers contribute their union. transfer_monotone preserves pointwise inclusion, while derivation_covered puts every finite abstract derivation inside any closed upper-bound assignment, including through recursive dependencies. Unknown is the universal predicate. Rust must establish that source extraction covers actual values, finite sets implement these operations, and a reported fixed point is closed after widening. The laws do not prove source admission, termination of the Rust attempt, arithmetic diagnostics or its resource behavior.

DomainBindings addresses a different filtering boundary: a local match may have no complete continuation. Conservative argument coverage makes the intersection for each source variable necessary, and kept_binding_survives keeps it necessary once every value a comparison over that variable alone excludes is removed, for the bindings the exclusion rule keeps. Selecting every row that can finish then preserves the exact ordered completion list, including multiplicity. The optional eager consumer applies these guards to the positive-flat rules of the exact normalized program, in every support-completion round and in final instantiation; the ordinary command requests it. Objective declarations may coexist with those rules because they introduce no argument values. Their local joins, checked arithmetic, tuple identity and costs retain ordinary evaluation. This applicability extension does not broaden the producer-scheduling certificate. Unknown, stopped and inapplicable analysis supply no narrowing. Concrete analyzer soundness, source/IR correspondence, dictionary identity, the agreement of the guard’s comparison verdict with the join’s, and recursive matching remain unproved implementation bridges. Prepared candidates now retain scoped source term IDs. Each support snapshot decodes them into its own relation dictionaries; the preservation premise concerns decoded values, not equality of numeric IDs across those authorities. The domain-binding guide also states the separate work, storage and authored-error obligations.

DomainContraction proves concrete singleton-distinctness and affine filters preserve compatible assignments under fixed constraints. Finite compositions preserve that family; an empty mandatory domain excludes the certified branch. Relating these assignments to answer sets requires a fixed assignment interpretation and sound recognition of the active constraints. The laws do not implement constraint recognition or establish source admission, support, minimality or existence. In particular, applying a filter before source evaluation requires a separate argument that required arithmetic errors remain observable. The domain guide distinguishes these prospective filters from the existing source-domain analysis.

The normal-rule and Ferraris foundations retain independent definitions. The NormalFerraris bridge proves their equivalence under the specified normalized-rule translation, including its filtered/direct-map distinction. The from_ground_program Rust translator is now removed; the bridge did not verify that implementation and does not verify current atom interning or formula DAG construction. FrozenReduct represents a fixed candidate’s reduct. The separate generated-code proofs establish its stored-mask invariant through actual construction and compose it with the public query under per-invocation reservation providers and fixed observations. Source lowering remains separate. PublicMembership supplies the generated public membership composition, and RuntimeMembership connects it to finite eventful reference checks. Interpretation construction has its finite-input and reservation-contract proof above.

FormulaNodes retains a completed topology-validation prefix across aggregate compilations. Its obligation is the inductive one in DagSharing.WellFormed.snoc: a previously admitted prefix remains unchanged, and each additional node names only earlier children. DagSharing.stored_meaning then explains why extending the table cannot change a prior formula’s meaning. DagSharing.intern_stable_under_extension additionally keeps an existing node’s exact index under append-only extension. A runtime cached node therefore needs the same owner and an unchanged prefix; a cache cannot survive a rollback past its entry merely because its atom still exists. The Rust owner must keep that paired prefix immutable and check every replacement suffix. Rollback and detachment restore the checkpoint’s validation frontier and numeric validation evidence, as well as every owned arena length: an unchecked raw span can temporarily borrow newly appended arena cells, so validation discovered inside that append cannot survive their removal. A checked logical append extends a fully validated prefix because it checks every child and constructs canonical storage; it cannot skip an unchecked raw prefix. This establishes topology only, leaving atom-universe admission separate. Its scalar, family and extremum methods reuse the existing compilers, without a formula rewrite. These laws describe the invariant; they do not verify the concrete validation cursor, cancellation, allocation or rollback accounting. Raw paired constructors retain their full-prefix checks.

EvaluationWorkspace computes original node truth before exposing a borrowed FormulaEvaluation. Rust’s ownership boundary ties that view to the exact interpretation and prevents reuse of its backing workspace while the view lives. The denotational satisfaction relation supplies the mathematical specification. The retained Boolean-generation laws establish its generated inner admission, evaluation and root scans under their stated library-value and observation contracts. They do not establish today’s numeric-row evaluator, even on Boolean input. EvaluationWorkspace’s row reuse, reservation, borrowed-view and retained-capacity wrapper, and its composition with changing runtime observations, remain refinement obligations. Independent syntax-tree controls also check satisfaction and asserted-root truth across a finite test family; those tests do not extend the generated-code proof boundary.

ParametricReduct proves that a fixed connective network agrees with frozen-reduct truth below a candidate when its original-truth parameters are accurate. Atoms read the tested subset; implication retains its original candidate-truth guard. The countermodel law covers every asserted root and a proper subset, while original candidate satisfaction remains separate. Its Rust correspondent, the clause search’s PreparedReduct, was removed with that search; the law remains as a statement, and the region query’s own correspondence is ReductRegions. Propagation.unconditional_sweeps_models_iff proves the abstract composition: intersecting arbitrary candidate domains with unconditional narrowing preserves exactly their completions of the same query. The unit propagator it described was removed with the clause search.

PositiveTheory characterizes complete atomic-head theories with monotone bodies, including positive cycles and exactly the truth constructor False → False. The least producer-closed interpretation is the sole possible answer set; it is an answer set exactly when all positive constraints hold there. Under this strict grammar, a failed constraint rules out every classical model. Rust PositivePlan uses that positive producer argument and the arbitrary-constraint extension below. Its CSR correspondence must establish sound activation, complete child incidences including aliases, finite queue exhaustion and complete constraint checking against the same owner. The law does not prove Rust indexing, allocation or work admission, nor source completeness or ordinary candidate enumeration. A dependency projection or class hint cannot replace the original-root certificate. See the reading guide.

ConstrainedPositive proves that any original constraint F → False satisfied by a candidate has a reduct true in every interpretation. It needs no subset or positive-body premise. Adding arbitrary constraints therefore filters existing answer sets without supplying support. For positive producers, the least consequences are the unique answer set exactly when the original constraints hold there. Failure rules out answer sets, but need not rule out larger classical models. Rust must classify every original root, compute closure only from positive producers, then evaluate the same original theory through EvaluationWorkspace. A false producer is an invariant refusal, not a constraint verdict. Exact evaluation consumes remaining work and counts its actual capacity beside the retained least interpretation after CSR release. The append/partition law does not prove those Rust ownership, work, first-error or source-completeness obligations.

ConstrainedPositive.stable_iff_frozen_least also permits a positive presentation of one candidate’s reduct. The original candidate must first satisfy the theory. For every subset of that candidate, satisfaction of the presentation must agree with satisfaction of the entire frozen reduct. Under those premises, the candidate is stable exactly when it equals the presentation’s least consequences. The original program need not be positive or acyclic. Recognizing all original roots, freezing negation, preserving atom identity and computing the least set from the empty interpretation remain executable correspondence obligations.

PossibleFoundedness gives a separate candidate restriction. An upper relaxation must retain every body whose frozen reduct can hold below a possible set P. If P is closed under every permitted head of every possible producer, complete producer and choice coverage implies that each compatible answer set is contained in P. The proof intersects an answer set with P, establishes a model of the whole reduct, and applies minimality. It requires a closed upper set, not necessarily the least one; it does not choose one disjunctive head. body_upper_sound justifies the positive Boolean relaxation with candidate-valid false masks. body_upper_mono establishes the relaxation’s order property: shrinking possible atoms and adding false marks cannot make an impossible body possible. It does not assert monotonicity of an arbitrary closed set selected by a computation. A founded Subject still needs an explicitly related regional result and closure computation. Rust must additionally establish complete extraction, native aggregate relaxation, flattened-incidence correspondence, completed closure, valid cached acyclicity and exact interruption/accounting. Those obligations are not discharged by the semantic theorem or the small exhaustive tests.

Rust restricts repeated closure to heads in exact positive cyclic components. Every uncut noncyclic atom is a conceptual seed; held cyclic atoms are not seeds. Complete cyclic-head bodies retain all Boolean and opaque boundary inputs, so the resulting set is closed under every producer. Only missing cyclic heads are published as cuts. One pass can be weaker than whole-program closure; ordinary Boolean/support propagation and cyclic closure alternate to saturation. Equality at saturation additionally requires induction over the complete positive component order: an acyclic input to a cyclic component must precede it, and ordinary propagation must expose every false relaxed Boolean body. Exact component recognition, boundary invalidation, saturated equality and the packed publication remain Rust refinement obligations. Exhaustive partial-region and complete-family comparisons supply executable evidence, not a formal proof of this implementation.

On exact-owner reuse, the body projection also prepares ordered parent incidences whose destinations are included, nonabsorbed Boolean nodes. Omitted destinations are either outside the projection or opaque inputs initialized true or inactive; their parent events cannot change the closure. Every remaining occurrence keeps its original order and multiplicity. This filtering depends only on the immutable theory, never on a region’s false mask. The same preparation flattens producer heads into ordered cyclic-head rows, including a separate row for selected facts. It retains every relevant occurrence, while keeping original producers available for explanation coverage. Parallel to the selected body nodes, an immutable role records each node’s initial state or noncyclic boundary atom. Current node and atom falsity determine each reinitialized state; no prior body closure truth is reused. The first pass uses original rows and node kinds; included cells remain included even after their runtime state changes. The parent rows, head rows and roles publish together under the exact owner. Preparation also partitions selected IDs and roles together, placing mutable counters before seed roles. Full replay resets the counters first. It then reads the current masks for each seed and immediately replays a true seed’s outgoing rows; ordinary atom and derived-node events drain only after all seeds have current states. Projected parents cannot target boundary or opaque seeds, and an empty conjunction has no incoming occurrence. These conditions justify removing initial seeds from the queue while retaining every activation once. No previous closure truth is reused, and cuts still require full completion. The first pass retains the queued schedule. Alignment of the partition, reset before replay, complete outgoing incidences and equality of the two completed closures are executable refinement obligations; the semantic upper-set law needs no change. Exhaustive mask comparisons against the queued schedule give regression evidence, not a Lean proof of these Rust operations. Construction and retained capacities are charged; a failed preparation clears that authority and a retry repeats body preparation. Producer-free restrictions and frozen-reduct passes do not consume or invalidate this preparation. Their separate knowledge never establishes founded completion; returning to a producer-backed original subject authenticates the retained owner before false events. A genuinely different original still discards foreign authority. Preservation of completed closure across the different event schedules remains a Rust correspondence obligation; interruption tests also exercise partial preparation and current-mask resets.

Inherited completion also requires a reuse argument: the prepared positive body projection belongs to the exact original theory, and no relevant input has become false. An atom with no occurrence in that projection can only remove itself from the previous upper closure; remaining uncut atoms stay covered. Ordinary propagation must still invalidate completion when an opaque body becomes false. Unknown, foreign or interrupted preparation supplies no exclusion evidence. The Rust membership states, event invalidation and sibling isolation remain refinement obligations; the semantic closure theorem alone does not verify this reuse.

PossibleFoundedness.stable_sub_locally_closed separates selected heads from boundary seeds. If every permitted atom outside the selection belongs to P, and all enabled ordinary and choice producers entering the selection are closed in P, the whole possible set is producer-closed. Complete coverage and a sound upper relaxation then put every compatible answer set inside P. The selection may be arbitrary: this law establishes safe exclusion, not equality with a least closure, and does not assume or prove inherited completion.

PossibleFoundedness.PublicationErasure.erasure_preserves_least_closed proves that erasing atoms outside a monotone operator’s least closed set from both inputs and outputs preserves that least set. The positive formula relaxation instantiates this law through completed_publication_preserves_least. whole_publication_baseline also establishes that every surviving permitted cyclic head belongs to the completed closure after all missing cyclic heads have been published. Erasing a partial publication prefix still preserves the least set, but does not establish that all remaining cyclic heads belong to it. The boundary precedes dependent ordinary propagation; it does not freeze opaque body truth across that later work or establish answer-set membership.

Rust’s selective replay collects false events from an authenticated completed original baseline. That baseline may be inherited at entry or re-established after a completed founded pass publishes its whole missing-head set. Exact owner and projection authentication are repeated immediately before replay. A stopped publication prefix cannot rearm collection; a completed pass without new publication does not supply a new event boundary. Its forward cone must include every affected live cyclic head H, from all false inputs since that baseline, including opaque bodies and already-false occurrences of newly cut atoms. Rearming may clear the completed founded event history, but must retain pending ordinary events and collect subsequent atom cuts and ordinary false events. It does not mark ordinary closure or founded confirmation complete. Inputs a sibling recorded before it was refuted or stopped describe that sibling’s region alone; the next inherited narrowing resets those marks, one charged operation per mark, before it collects, so they never enter its cone and grant no authority. Forward traversal may stop at a currently false destination only because a newly false input retains its own notification and an older false input was inactive at the completed baseline. The head-prefix partition must preserve every discovered vertex, head order and membership marks; it does not supply new closure authority. Reverse selection must cover every producer entering an uncut head in H and every relevant relaxed Boolean operand in B(H). A current false body may stop reverse traversal only because initialization keeps it inactive; any operand needed through another live path remains selected. A cut head cannot activate and needs no incoming producer evaluation. Fresh initialization and filtered shared events must saturate that complete body selection while seeding unaffected uncut atoms. The result must include the boundary seeds as well as the local closure before publication or explanation capture. Proving that no newly invalidated unblocked dependency can change a boundary seed, and that the selected completed baseline justifies those seeds in the current least closure of the full cyclic-head relaxation, remains an executable correspondence obligation. Complete producer coverage, n-ary Boolean projection and native opaque-body treatment must realize the formula-level law; it does not verify the indexed Rust DAG. Further correspondence obligations include occurrence multiplicity, sibling isolation, full fallback, typed interruption and actual storage accounting. Exhaustive cut comparisons and interrupted-prefix tests supply regression evidence for these obligations; the partition law does not discharge them or establish a performance result.

PossibleFoundedness.conditional_unsupported_absent states the reusable conditional law. For every answer set satisfying condition B, the same upper relaxation must be sound below the complement of U. Every ordinary producer whose head meets U and every atomic choice into U must be disabled. Applying stable_sub_possible to that complement then excludes every atom of U. This covers partial conditions independently of the ancestor region that exposed them; a classical model or a model of a frozen reduct need not satisfy the cut.

PossibleFoundedness.conditional_unsupported_forces_complement gives the corresponding deduction from an incomplete match. If C ∧ ell excludes U, an answer set satisfying C and containing an atom of U cannot satisfy ell. The proof applies the conditional absence law and contradicts that present atom. The conditions are arbitrary interpretation predicates; the law does not model Rust’s signed coordinates or its classification of partial knowledge.

The Rust collector starts from one uncut atom missing after a completed original founded pass, before publishing that pass’s cuts. It prefers a held atom; if no missing atom is held, it may capture an open one. The conditional absence law does not require the starting atom to be held: complete producer coverage with sound false-body witnesses establishes that conclusion. Discovery, collection and redundancy checks keep the same optional allowance. The collector reconstructs every incoming producer’s false-body witness using positive Boolean structure, absent external atoms and exact negated atoms whose atom is held. A conjunction needs one false operand; a disjunction needs them all. Other implications supply no witness. Adding an unsupported atom requires checking all its producers, and a failed alternative rolls back its speculative additions. A held cohead cannot discharge that coverage duty.

AggregateBodyWitnesses states the corresponding aggregate-body laws. Every omitted contribution has a false reduct outside the removed set under the recorded condition. A nonnegative threshold fails when the total of all remaining possible contributions is below its bound. Interior ordinal cuts fail when every qualifying contribution is false; endpoint cuts require their separate constant laws. The false-body property is preserved when the removed set grows, but every added atom still needs complete producer coverage.

Rust implements threshold collection with a bounded frame cursor over the original weighted row. Successfully explained occurrences reduce the remaining possible weight; failed contributions roll back only their speculative additions. Unexplained occurrences keep their full weight. Zero weights need no condition witness. Native min/max cuts reuse their prepared qualifying disjunctions; endpoint constants are handled first, and an interior cut with no chain is verified by a charged scan. The laws do not prove the cursor, finite-width sums, rollback, rank classification or original-row identity.

The worker-local ledger holds one tier of an owner’s rows. The owner (LearningOwner) names the class, today the answer sets of one exact original theory, and the tier’s limits. Only the owner’s carrier, a subject built by OriginalSubject::carrier over the owner’s own theory, matches and captures, so every captured row belongs to the owner’s class; capture also requires complete producer coverage. Restriction, bound, filter and frozen visits are not carriers and suspend reuse; a carrier of a different class clears the rows. A complete match gives each open output its sign or refutes a contradicted output. With exactly one unknown signed condition, all others satisfied and an output’s opposite decided, Rust instead forces the unknown condition’s opposite through the existing atom events (consequence_row_forces_complement). A condition known opposite disables the row; multiple unknowns or no contradicted output do not authorize this additional deduction. By default a tier retains at most 64 rows after at most 256 capture attempts, sharing 131,072 discovery, collection and redundancy-comparison reads. One collection permits at most 64 unsupported atoms, 16 literals, 4,096 reads and 65,536 workspace bytes. A consolidated row keeps the same 64-distinct-output bound. A full tier evicts the row with the fewest decayed hits, oldest first, except founded rows within their reserved floor, which by default is the whole tier; deleting a row loses pruning only (row_dominance needs no deleted row). Consolidation does not expand the discovery allowance. Matching remains charged to ordinary narrowing work. Optional limits decline capture; global quota, cancellation and allocation failures preserve their typed outcomes.

Above 64 rows a matching step reads an occurrence index covering every row’s condition and output atoms. The Rust obligation is that the index skips only rows whose deduction cannot have changed: within one narrowing knowledge only grows and a deduction reads only the row’s atoms, so the rows the index omits for the atoms decided since the previous step have the deductions that step applied. A narrowing’s first step and the step after any change test every row, and an interrupted rebuild is never read. Exhaustive comparison of indexed and scanning tiers over partial regions checks this obligation; no Lean law states it.

The store (LearnedStore in zetesis-stable, over zetesis-ferraris’s LearningStore) holds rows by class. Its Rust obligations: a tier delivers only under its own owner’s class, so every store row of a class was learned by that class’s carrier and is a row of the class (founded_row for every row today); seeding and delivery are retention, publishing only complete rows under the same allowances, typed stops and transactional failure as capture; they run only at walk boundaries, never inside a narrowing, so one narrowing reads one tier throughout; and no store row reaches a membership check or a coverage claim. Sharing needs no new law: RowOf does not mention regions, so a row of a class is a row for every walk of that class, and dropping one, by eviction or by the quality filter, loses pruning only.

PossibleFoundedness.conditional_unsupported_union combines already established absence consequences under the same interpretation condition by taking the union of their unsupported atoms. Their producer witnesses may differ. The ledger can therefore share outputs when its signed conditions are identical. PossibleFoundedness.conditional_unsupported_dominance transfers an absence consequence to a stronger condition and a smaller output set: a row requiring a subset of another row’s signed conditions and excluding a superset of its outputs subsumes that row. This supports either omitting a new row or retiring an old one after a stronger replacement is retained. Both laws concern answer sets of the same original theory, not arbitrary classical models or frozen queries.

Concrete condition identity, complete ordered union and inclusion, preservation of partial-match deductions, and publication of a completed replacement remain Rust obligations. Union and retirement must preserve the existing capture bounds, optional allowance, typed failure behavior and retained/transient storage accounting. These laws do not prove the ledger’s representation or propagation.

LearnedRegions states the general row. A row pairs condition literals B with output literals O, each an atom required present or absent, and belongs to a consequence class C, a predicate on interpretations, when every member of C satisfying B satisfies O (RowOf). For a region whose bounds decide every condition, consequence_row_refutes excludes every member of C when the region also decides an output’s negation, consequence_row_forces gives every member every output, and consequence_row_narrows restates that as Region.narrow_preserves_valid’s premise with C as the valid predicate. consequence_row_forces_complement is the unit rule: with every condition but one decided and an output’s negation decided, the remaining condition fails in every member. row_of_narrower_class carries a row to any narrower class, so a row of the original theory’s answer sets also holds for the answer sets satisfying a streamed core. row_union and row_dominance generalize the union and dominance laws above to signed outputs. founded_row is the possible-foundedness collector’s discharge of RowOf: it restates conditional_unsupported_absent for a condition given as signed literals and outputs given as absences, with the theory’s answer sets as C. The laws are over interpretations and regions; the ledger’s encoding, matching, retention, eviction, ownership, delivery between workers and resource handling remain Rust obligations, stated with the ledger below.

CountermodelReuse states when a proper subset that refutes one candidate also refutes a larger one. LearnedRegions.antimonotone_superset_refutes requires that enlarging a classical candidate preserve reduct models below the smaller one. witness_rules_persistent proves that premise for positive facts and rules with a positive head and a conjunction of positive formulas and default-negated atoms in the body. This includes disjunctive heads and integrity constraints. falsum_free_countermodel_does_not_refute_superset gives a theory with no occurrence of falsum where the implication fails. Recognizing a proved fragment in a Rust formula DAG and attaching its witness to a candidate row remain implementation obligations.

CountermodelReplay gives a separate rule for any finite propositional theory in the Ferraris grammar. LearnedRegions.replayNodes selects formula occurrences at a fixed witness. A false conjunction or true disjunction can use one decisive branch. At a nested implication, the selection also records whether its original root was true: a false root freezes to falsum even if its antecedent would be false at the witness. replay_nodes_agree transfers the frozen reading when the two candidates contain the witness and agree on the selected nodes. countermodel_row_refutes applies this law to all original roots. A new candidate containing the witness and one extra atom cannot be stable under that agreement. It need not contain the old candidate. A concrete row would have to bind the validated witness and selected signed nodes to the same original theory and use node knowledge sound for every answer set in the region. Shared node IDs, supported lowered operators, extraction cost, row limits and publication remain implementation obligations.

NumericWitnessReplay uses one index into both columns of a numeric row. An occurrence retains its condition node even when it has zero weight or shares that node with another position. The original node mask and the guard on frozen predecessor values determine the reduct reading. The guards cover an inclusive signed threshold and both ordinal cuts with their empty endpoints. The corresponding Rust owners are NumericStorage::view and cut_view in zetesis-ferraris/src/theory/numeric.rs, the threshold and extremum reductions, and oracle::evaluate and oracle::evaluate_node. The proof starts at the admitted span, using exact arithmetic. Extraction of descriptor and owner identity, machine bounds, cache validity and source tuple coalescing remain implementation obligations.

For a candidate region that already holds a proper witness and another atom, known_countermodel_refutes_region discharges a selected original root from modelhood. Other selected signs must be known in the same original theory and region. FormulaBounds.Known suffices for that theorem. A deduction specific to stable completions needs its own preservation argument, as does reading the Rust node-knowledge mask. No learned fact enters a membership check.

MixedFormulaGraph composes the numeric row and finite operand laws across an immutable mixed graph. The checked reader resolves a descriptor on its own columns, verifies the row domain, and requires every operand occurrence to refer to an earlier node. An indexed original and frozen pass computes the two complete Ferraris truth columns from the empty prefix. The root theorem checks the original root IDs in order, including repetitions. The Rust correspondence starts at admitted Theory::view and numeric storage. Actual group views may borrow an inline pair or an arena slice. The proof uses their ordered contents, mathematical indices and exact arithmetic. Compiled extraction and refusal costs remain separate obligations.

StableProducerKnowledge follows the candidate support scan in zetesis-ferraris/src/regions/support.rs. An ordinary row is unavailable when its body is known false or a different head is held. Atomic choices use the body test alone. With complete producer coverage every stable completion containing the atom retains a supporter. An empty scan therefore excludes the atom; a held atom with one surviving source forces that source’s body. Either sign can justify a later scan or a witness condition in the same region. The class here is the stable completions. The root and witness checks still use the original theory and its own frozen reduct. Authenticating a particular shared-node justification, inherited cursor skips, and the other sources of region knowledge remain separate from the full producer-filter law.

SignedOriginal relates each signed node ID to its position on the same decoded mixed graph. A numeric guard’s false original mask already fixes its frozen value. When that guard is true, agreement on its referenced condition IDs transfers the guard between candidates.

CheckedSignedReplay checks a proposed witness row. It confirms the old frozen roots and each submitted original sign, then restores the positive signs of asserted roots. At the fixed witness, it propagates definite bits through the mixed graph. A decisive operand suffices for an ordinary conjunction or disjunction. A false original numeric mask settles the node; a true guard can be computed when its child occurrences are known. The checker requires every asserted root to be definitely true. Unknown bits and absent IDs cannot supply evidence. The theorem checked_row_excludes proves the old proper countermodel and excludes a stable completion of a region holding the witness and an additional atom, provided the nonroot facts hold of stable completions in that region. It does not assume the selector covered enough nodes; the executable check establishes sufficiency. Rust would still need to authenticate the witness, root and sign owners at row creation and use, connect actual region knowledge to those signed facts, and enforce the row and work allowances. This check is a reference over the graph. The solver does not install or prune with it.

RegionalOriginal establishes the signed facts needed by the witness check. Starting with the atoms held or cut in a region, a forward scan reads the graph in node order. For a numeric guard it evaluates the least and greatest possible selections of its input occurrences. When both give the same result, every completion has that reading. An unknown input can therefore leave the guard decided.

RegionalProducer adds one round of producer reasoning between two such scans. If a held atom has exactly one surviving producer, its body must hold in every stable completion. The proof requires a complete inventory for the original theory and a checked link from each recorded body ID to its formula. A descendant can use these signs when it still holds the witness and at least one more atom. A sibling must establish the signs in its own region. The Rust a_countermodel_operand_sign_is_local_to_its_branch test exercises this distinction on an implication whose sign changes between siblings. Correspondence for the production producer inventory and for storing and charging witness rows remains open.

AlgebraicRows states algebraic consequences for any consequence class, as RowOf does. A term pairs an atom with a value, and a list of terms is measured in an interpretation by folding a commutative monoid (AxisFolds.Reduction) over the values of the terms whose atoms hold; measure_congr makes the measure local to the terms’ atoms. In an abelian group, equations of a class add (equation_sum), terms with inverse values cancel (measure_cancel), and literals giving every other atom its value isolate one atom’s contribution (equation_isolates). The isolated value forces the atom true or false, a row of the class (equation_forces_true, equation_forces_false), or excludes the conditions given (equation_excludes, equation_excludes_given); excludes_region and consequence_row_forces carry either into a region that decides the conditions (decides_truth). In an ordered commutative monoid, two families of rows covering the same terms exclude the class when their lower bounds’ fold does not lie below their upper bounds’ (double_count_excludes). In a region, held atoms may raise a lower bound and atoms not cut lower an upper bound (lower_in_of_held, upper_in_of_possible, double_count_excludes_region), and cut_excludes_region accepts a bipartite cut certificate whose missed terms count as the region’s held and open atoms. The instances are parity, the Booleans under exclusive-or (parity_forces), and counting, the natural numbers under addition, which count_measure connects to PartitionCapacities (double_count_groups).

A row enters its class through its provenance, checked once. entailed_by_patterns gives every model of a group of formulas a property that depends only on a set of atoms the formulas mention, provided every interpretation inside the set that violates the property violates a formula of the group; it rests on Ferraris.satisfies_congr, and entailed_by_part carries the property to the answer sets of any theory containing the group. entailed_by_completion does the same for an atom’s completion, from DisjunctiveSupport.answer_set_completion, which requires a complete inventory in which every producer of the atom is a normal rule with it as its sole head and no choice has it; xor_definition is the two-rule exclusive-or instance. lower_of_threshold and upper_of_negated_threshold read a count bound from a threshold whose conditions are atoms, with the weights as the terms’ values, and guard_releases applies a guarded constraint where its guard holds.

The bounded source views use conjunction_assoc_original, conjunction_chain_original and conjunction_flatten_original to read nested conjunctions with their leaf occurrences intact. canonical_truth_original authenticates the meaning of the exact False -> False formula, and truth_implication_original gives TRUE -> F the original truth of F. double_negated_conjunction_original composes the existing Ferraris.double_neg_satisfies law with the conjunction reading; this is original satisfaction, not permission to erase double negation in a frozen reduct. bounds_of_asserted_conjunction composes the lower and upper threshold laws for a conjunction containing both positive and negated thresholds. The Rust recognizers and independent source checkers must authenticate these exact contexts against the original root, visit and charge every source occurrence, preserve the existing distinct-atom and guard requirements, and finish checking all eligible children before publishing their family. These source views leave the original theory and its reduct unchanged; traversal, complete provenance, atomic publication and resource accounting remain implementation obligations.

The library also provides entailed_fact_step for an ordered sequence of proved positive facts and entailed_by_residual_patterns for recognizing a source under those facts. The latter explicitly requires correspondence to the original roots; removing fact atoms does not make the original formula mention fewer atoms. arithmetic::root_facts prepares ordered witnesses through the same activation kernel as positive evaluation, then independently replays each original rule against earlier checked facts. Only replay constructs the packed fact mask used by clause recognition and its provenance checker. Negative premises and non-atomic heads are not fact sources. Source A checks its raw eight-atom limit and distinctness before conditioning; a known positive leaf disappears from the residual condition, while a known atom’s negative leaf makes that condition false. Source B and cardinality guards keep their existing rules. The laws do not verify the Rust occurrence transpose, queue schedule, witness order, owner checks or metering. The retained facts never enter frozen-reduct membership search.

Original-candidate preparation in zetesis-ferraris now recognizes bounded parity and counting structure. arithmetic::rows checks local truth patterns against their original constraint roots (entailed_by_patterns, entailed_by_part); arithmetic::completion reads the complete normal, sole-head producer span (entailed_by_completion). Independent source rereads check each proposed equation before arithmetic::parity eliminates rows. equation_of_agreement, parity_measure_odd and parity_equation_of_xor connect the packed XOR representation to equation_add. Root units and contradictions use the consequences stated by parity_forces, equation_excludes_given and excludes_region.

Completion tables compose packed intersections of signed atom columns, unions over all producers, and XOR with the head column. AxisFolds.all_fold_true_iff, any_fold_true_iff and AlgebraicRows.completion_fold_false_iff state the pointwise meaning of these reductions, including empty and repeated lists. The concrete periodic columns, padding and metering remain Rust obligations. Both occurrence traversals and every independent source check are retained; within each traversal, the walker may borrow its caller’s already-read entry view from the same immutable owner.

The local affine-hull reduction stops inserting differences once its span has full rank, but still counts all remaining allowed patterns to decide exactness. AxisFolds.pair_foldFrom_left_absorbing states this separation: an absorbing coordinate stays fixed while the other coordinate continues its reduction. The echelon invariant establishing that the machine rank test recognizes full span remains an implementation obligation. Full span alone does not establish that the allowed set equals its affine hull.

arithmetic::cardinality_source checks threshold and clause provenance (lower_of_threshold, upper_of_negated_threshold, lower_of_clause), retaining each guard. Its uniform-weight normalization corresponds to ThresholdDivision.rounded_bound_le_iff; handling signed machine bounds and executing the division remain Rust obligations. arithmetic::cardinality proposes families and independently checks that each side is a disjoint partition of the same atoms before comparing its lower and upper totals (double_count_excludes). A guarded bound does not become unconditional: guard_releases requires its guard to hold.

The original-candidate routes consume a checked root refutation or a root seeded by parity units; the frozen-reduct search receives neither these rows nor that root state. The region-inspection library extends these checked systems without recognizing new source rows during search.

zetesis_ferraris::ParitySystem::inspect_reserved reads touched basis rows against one input region, records that input in ParityKnowledge, then applies collected consequences in basis order. The snapshot precedes application, so a new decision remains a trigger for the next inspection. AlgebraicRows.parity_forces, equation_excludes_given and excludes_region supply the value-level argument; LearnedRegions.consequence_row_forces carries a forced row into the region. The shared zetesis_algebra::region::SubjectStep::Changed denotes progress, not local or joint closure.

After exact touched-row selection, parity uses the existing metered words::first to detect an empty mask. PackedWordIterator.first_set_none_iff states that completed absence means every stored word is zero; interrupted scans establish no such result. With no selected bit, the old row loop has no row consumer and the already-cleared consequence vector stays empty. The runtime can omit rebuilding its open mask and the vacuous row/application work, while still publishing the inspected input before returning Unchanged. This is not a permanent absorption flag: unrelated decisions are published, and later incident decisions select rows normally. Validation, system identity preconditions and the completed incidence-selection correspondence remain necessary. Executing fewer operations changes bounded receipts and quota observations; the packed value law does not establish those effects.

zetesis_ferraris::CardinalitySystem::inspect_reserved retains a complete input snapshot and two sums per checked family pair in CardinalityKnowledge. It reconstructs each affected occurrence’s old and current bounds, replacing its contribution before testing for exclusion. The general laws separate three obligations:

Lean lawsMathematical premise and conclusionRust counterpart
Zetesis.Algebra.guardedLower_sound, guardedUpper_soundThe original guarded bound holds for the class. A decided guard permits its bound to strengthen the held lower count or cap the possible upper count.arithmetic::cardinality_runtime::values::effective
Zetesis.Algebra.guardedLower_mono, guardedUpper_antitoneUnder Inside current prior, the effective natural lower bound grows and the effective upper bound shrinks.Reconstructing bounds from the retained and current region masks
Zetesis.AlgebraicRows.counting_replace_occurrenceSubtracting the selected old summand and adding its replacement gives the exact natural fold; other occurrences remain unchanged.arithmetic::cardinality_runtime::values::replace
Zetesis.AlgebraicRows.partial_double_count_excludes_regionBoth complete families cover the same terms, old bounds hold in an enclosing region and new bounds hold in the current region. Any mixture whose lower fold exceeds its upper fold excludes the current region.The first contradictory pair during occurrence refresh

The partial-refresh exclusion law needs validity of both choices of bound, not numerical monotonicity. Its complete-family premise is not permission to omit unrefreshed summands. The runtime count uses finite machine values; the natural-number laws do not prove its subtraction, addition or refusal paths.

Both kernels use the existing Words, Meter and NarrowingScratch primitives. Their ArithmeticAttempt retains performed work on success or failure. Knowledge reuse requires the same prepared system and an ancestor input; width and descent checks do not authenticate system identity. The copy_reserved operations preserve the source and make a failed destination unavailable. Ordinary Clone does not provide metered copying.

Rows prepared from the original theory are consequences for its answer sets. The frozen countermodel walk uses rows proved for its own candidate and reduct. The default candidate schedules omit per-region parity and cardinality inspections after root preparation. When composing these inspections, the common Subject driver orders parity, cardinality and streamed constraints after the eager subjects. A changed late subject restarts eager propagation. The source adapter retains its own first-call marker so its first visit starts a source pass.

CandidateKnowledge keeps the arithmetic snapshots separate from restriction and objective generations. The charged copy operation preserves parent state and makes a refused child unavailable. Each returned attempt publishes its work and applied decisions before its outcome is handled. Completed inspections and semantic refutations have separate activity fields; an interrupted attempt claims neither. The frozen countermodel walk records its own arithmetic in ReductStatistics::inner_preparation.

The general laws do not establish the adapters’ exact permit ownership, refund, publication or concurrent lifetime behavior. Those remain executable refinement and qualification obligations, including refusal during a bounded arithmetic operation and differences in scratch or child-storage reuse across schedules.

Source ownership, complete producer inventories, packing and padded incidence strides, touched-row coverage, snapshot publication, sibling isolation, retained and transient storage, typed refusal and cancellation remain Rust refinement obligations. The laws prove neither that refinement nor host/device equivalence. Flow witnesses remain separate work.

Retained rows use either the scalar witness lists or sparse word groups, chosen by actual buffer capacity including the common row header. A packed row keeps premise words and output words in separate ordered spans of one allocation. The scalar collector remains temporary; conversion peak accounting includes both buffers. Packed matching must preserve the same complete, partial and opposite condition classifications, and decoding must preserve canonical atom identity and ascending output events. Publication filters each packed output word before decoding, required absences by held | !cut and required presences by cut | !held: settled outputs need no event, while contradicted outputs retain precedence. The cursor is local to one traversal, and publication may cut its returned atom but cannot drain other propagation between visits. Word reads and emitted outputs remain charged; interruption supplies no completed traversal. These representation obligations are checked against exhaustive scalar readings and bounded interruption tests; the generic conditional-absence laws do not prove that Rust refinement.

These theorems do not prove Rust extraction, signed atom identity, Boolean witness traversal, complete producer coverage, exact-owner matching or resource accounting. For the additional deduction, Rust must distinguish an unknown condition from one already known opposite, establish every remaining premise and a held output, and propagate the opposite signed value without changing original-only scope. Those representation and runtime correspondences remain open. Exhaustive small original theories and partial-region tests check semantic preservation, and scope/interruption tests exercise the executable boundaries; they do not close that formal gap or replace the reduct membership check.

The CPU positive candidate cursor uses positive_stable_iff as a coverage law: only the completed least interpretation can belong to the answer-set family. It proposes that interpretation once if the original constraints and candidate conditions permit it, retaining ordinary membership checking. A failed original constraint instead completes the empty family. Rust must preserve the exact certificate owner, every additional restriction and streamed constraint, and successful completion before reporting exhaustion. Cancellation or a work/allocation refusal cannot be substituted for the empty-family case. The mathematical law does not verify that cursor, its packed copy, batch publication or worker accounting.

TerminalDefinitions separates arbitrary base atoms from new derived atoms using a disjoint sum. Each definition has one derived head and a positive conjunction of base atoms; the base theory never reads derived atoms. stable_iff characterizes every full answer set as a base answer set plus exactly its definition consequences. stable_extend_iff and unique_stable_extension give membership preservation and a unique full extension of each base answer set. Several producers of one head contribute by existential union; empty bodies and duplicate occurrences are allowed. The frozen-reduct characterization requires a subset of a candidate satisfying the definitions and imposes consequence containment. Minimality, rather than classical satisfaction alone, excludes extra derived atoms.

Applying this law to source programs still requires a complete semantic partition: every producer occurrence, all body scopes and implicit coherence constraints must respect the base/derived separation. Ground-instance coverage, preserved source diagnostics, canonical owner correspondence, reconstruction before publishing a full answer, and failure and coverage accounting remain unproved implementation obligations. This one-layer theorem does not establish a recursive definition schedule or certify a source or runtime optimization.

The executable consumer is formula_terminal. Its partition matches the exact normalized source to every selected IR producer and scans remaining semantic reads. Reconstruction joins true base-model rows and publishes their union with derived heads through one canonical descendant store. TerminalSession retains the original input, counts only completed extensions as original answers, and records an unfinished extension separately. Over a hybrid base its base session yields only core answers the streamed constraints accepted, so each answer is checked, then extended, then published: the composition rests on StreamedConstraints.stable_iff_completed_partition for the base and TerminalDefinitions.stable_iff for the extension, and no streamed constraint reads a deferred head, so deferral changes no constraint’s truth. These Rust checks implement the stated obligations; the existing theorem does not prove their source-to-proposition or machine-execution correspondence.

StreamedConstraints adds an executable finite scan beneath that filtering law. A violation names an original occurrence, completion certifies that every checked body is false, and interruption retains the suffix after a checked false prefix. A partition’s flattened occurrences must be a permutation of the complete source family. completed_partition and partition_invariance preserve the completed satisfaction verdict across chunk sizes and orders; they do not preserve the first violation or authorize acceptance before every required part completes. stable_iff_completed_partition combines pointwise Boolean-to-formula original truth with the append law for an arbitrary retained theory. Concrete source lowering, local and aggregate-family completeness, arithmetic admission, prepared owner identity, cursor coverage and bounded execution remain separate obligations. The occurrence-count fuel bound does not bound Rust join or expression work; less retained materialization need not mean less replay work. See the constraint-stream guide.

Hybrid retention grounds some eligible templates in the retained theory instead of streaming them. The law needs no change: stable_iff_completed_partition already takes an arbitrary retained theory, here the producer core with the grounded templates’ instances. ConstrainedPositive.stable_append_constraints, applied once to the grounded instances and once to the streamed ones, shows that how the eligible constraints are split between the two leaves exactly the answer sets of the theory that grounds every instance. The Rust obligations are that a grounded template’s instances are emitted as eager grounding emits a constraint, over the same completed join that capture counted; that the retired templates are exactly the grounded ones; and that retention creates no atom, so completion’s guards still cover every atom.

The hybrid executor composes this law with either CPU or GPU core membership. Host source consequences narrow only original candidate regions. The device checks the retained core; complete streamed acceptance still precedes scoring, bound feedback and publication. Device batches may contain core answers awaiting that acceptance, so core membership and original-answer counts remain distinct. The law is independent of the execution backend.
